rubrics.title: Original portal advertisement

criteria.name: Editable image control

descriptors.Beginning: Missing subject areas or background fragments interrupt the image; cannot yet locate the controlling edit.
descriptors.Developing: Uses layers/mask but repairs require modelling or leave visible problems at output size.
descriptors.Secure: Independently selects the correct layer/mask and repairs relevant edges while preserving editable sources.
descriptors.Extending: Adapts edge/placement method to a changed source and explains why that repair suits the new condition.

criteria.collection: P: PSD/export; O: independent repair; C: locate controlling edit.
criteria.repair: Revisit a single mask-error example; make a fresh independent repair.

criteria.name: Hierarchy and design

descriptors.Beginning: Reader cannot identify the main message; type or contrast prevents reading.
descriptors.Developing: Main message emerges but spacing, contrast or competing elements still distract; revision needs prompting.
descriptors.Secure: Type roles, spacing, contrast and arrangement establish the intended first-read message at output size.
descriptors.Extending: Adapts hierarchy to a changed audience/format and uses a reader comparison to justify the choice.

criteria.collection: P: advert/A-B; C: explain reader test.
criteria.repair: Change one hierarchy variable and repeat the five-second read test.

criteria.name: Communication and judgement

descriptors.Beginning: Image/message lacks a clear link to the supplied audience or purpose.
descriptors.Developing: Some choices fit the brief but explanation names preferences without showing their effect.
descriptors.Secure: Image and message suit the brief; explanation points to visible evidence and a useful revision.
descriptors.Extending: Weighs two plausible treatments, tests the choice and explains a condition where the alternative would work better.

criteria.collection: P: original/revision; C: design defence.
criteria.repair: Identify intended action, point to supporting visual evidence and revise a conflicting element.

rubrics.conversion: No automatic percentage or IB grade conversion; teacher applies approved reporting policy
rubrics.review_note: Recovered existing rubric. Review terminology, support language and outcome links before approving for field capture.

rubrics.title: Independent surface mockup

criteria.name: Surface integration

descriptors.Beginning: Graphic conflicts with obvious edges, scale or surface cues and cannot yet be repaired.
descriptors.Developing: Placement is plausible in part; integration needs prompting or causes unexplained colour/detail loss.
descriptors.Secure: Independently adapts placement and tonal/mask treatment to the supplied surface with coherent visible form.
descriptors.Extending: Handles a changed surface condition, compares alternatives and repairs side effects while preserving the intended identity.

criteria.collection: P: surface PSD/export; O: repair; C: explain method.
criteria.repair: Compare flat/integrated versions; repair one cue without changing every control.

criteria.name: Reversible production

descriptors.Beginning: Only flattened/destructive result available; key source or edit cannot be located.
descriptors.Developing: Some editable structure remains but inconsistent layer naming or destructive edits limit changes.
descriptors.Secure: Named layers and editable sources allow an independent requested change and a usable handoff.
descriptors.Extending: Organises variations and source dependencies so another person can make a specified change without rebuilding.

criteria.collection: P: source structure; O: requested edit.
criteria.repair: Rebuild a minimal layered example and test a changed colour/placement request.

criteria.name: Brand and audience

descriptors.Beginning: Graphic choices obscure the message or have no identifiable relationship to the brief.
descriptors.Developing: Recognisable identity is present but colour/type/placement rules conflict in places.
descriptors.Secure: Surface treatment and brand rules support readable identity and the brief’s audience.
descriptors.Extending: Adapts brand rules purposefully across advert and object and defends the adaptation with comparison evidence.

criteria.collection: P: brand card/mockup; C: defence.
criteria.repair: Name three brand rules; repair one inconsistency and verify at intended size.

rubrics.conversion: No automatic percentage or IB grade conversion; teacher applies approved reporting policy
rubrics.review_note: Recovered existing rubric. Review terminology, support language and outcome links before approving for field capture.

rubrics.title: Independent micro-market advert

criteria.name: Image and message

descriptors.Beginning: Image/text does not yet communicate the required offer or action.
descriptors.Developing: Offer is partly clear but image/message relationship or editable control needs prompting.
descriptors.Secure: Independently combines taught image/text methods into a clear response to the brief.
descriptors.Extending: Adapts the image/message to a changed audience and explains the resulting change in emphasis.

criteria.collection: P: PSD/export; O: edit; C: audience explanation.
criteria.repair: Reduce to one offer and one hero image, then restore only necessary detail.

criteria.name: Type, colour and hierarchy

descriptors.Beginning: Key information cannot be read or has no visible order.
descriptors.Developing: Some order exists but type roles or contrast/spacing remain inconsistent.
descriptors.Secure: Uses purposeful type and colour roles so the reader identifies main and supporting information.
descriptors.Extending: Uses a controlled comparison and reader evidence to adapt hierarchy to new constraints.

criteria.collection: P: advert/variants; C: explain colour-wheel relationship and contrast decision.
criteria.repair: Change one type or colour variable and rerun the reading test.

criteria.name: Output and revision

descriptors.Beginning: Required source/output is missing or cannot be used at the specified screen destination.
descriptors.Developing: Export/source exists but dimensions or readability require help to correct.
descriptors.Secure: Retains editable source, exports to the stated screen specification and documents a purposeful revision.
descriptors.Extending: Diagnoses a changed output constraint and verifies the adapted result at its destination.

criteria.collection: P: source/export/revision; O: export check.
criteria.repair: Compare actual file properties with the brief; correct and view at destination.

rubrics.conversion: No automatic percentage or IB grade conversion; teacher applies approved reporting policy
rubrics.review_note: Recovered existing rubric. Review terminology, support language and outcome links before approving for field capture.

rubrics.title: Advert-to-physical design transfer

criteria.name: Design continuity and fit

descriptors.Beginning: Sign/model does not fit or communicate the intended place/message.
descriptors.Developing: Graphic and physical form connect partly; measurements or placement need substantial prompting.
descriptors.Secure: Uses measured dimensions to fit a recognisable, readable identity to the model.
descriptors.Extending: Adapts sign/form to a changed dimension or viewing condition and verifies the result.

criteria.collection: P: sign/model/dimensions; O: fit test; C: trace decision.
criteria.repair: Measure the interface, make a paper proof and change one dimension.

criteria.name: Testing and improvement

descriptors.Beginning: No usable test observation links to a design change.
descriptors.Developing: Records a problem/change but test criterion or before/after comparison is unclear.
descriptors.Secure: Uses a named criterion, records observations, makes a relevant change and retests.
descriptors.Extending: Chooses a test that distinguishes competing explanations and justifies a further adaptation from results.

criteria.collection: P: test record; O: test; C: rationale.
criteria.repair: Replace “better” with a concrete observation and repeat the same test.

criteria.name: Safe, explainable process

descriptors.Beginning: Has not yet demonstrated the approved process; intervention is required before continuing.
descriptors.Developing: Follows the process with reminders and can explain some steps.
descriptors.Secure: Uses approved materials/tools safely and explains the assembly sequence and a design decision.
descriptors.Extending: Anticipates a relevant process constraint and adapts the plan within approved procedures, explaining the effect.

criteria.collection: O: process across lessons; C: sequence; P: documentation.
criteria.repair: Reteach and observe the specific procedure before access; safety cannot be compensated by a polished product.

rubrics.conversion: No automatic percentage or IB grade conversion; teacher applies approved reporting policy
rubrics.review_note: Recovered existing rubric. Review terminology, support language and outcome links before approving for field capture.

rubrics.title: Early Operation 7 transfer diagnostic — not an IB markscheme

criteria.name: Mechanism and contextual application

descriptors.Beginning: Explanation contains a central misconception or does not address the scenario’s system.
descriptors.Developing: Names stages accurately in part but causal links or scenario application are missing.
descriptors.Secure: Explains relevant stages causally and applies them to distinctive facts of this scenario.
descriptors.Extending: Uses the mechanism to explain a changed condition or limitation and avoids overgeneralising the model.

criteria.collection: P: timed response; C: explain a stage without headings.
criteria.repair: Reconstruct the pipeline and explain the change caused by one altered input/control.

criteria.name: Evidence and conceptual analysis

descriptors.Beginning: Claims lack support or concepts appear only as labels.
descriptors.Developing: Some evidence and stakeholder effects appear but their analytical relationship is weak.
descriptors.Secure: Uses relevant evidence to explain stakeholder control/values relationships and distinguishes fact from inference.
descriptors.Extending: Connects evidence and perspective limits to a concept-driven interpretation of the unfamiliar situation.

criteria.collection: P: response/evidence links; C: what establishes that claim?
criteria.repair: Rewrite one concept label as a mechanism–control–consequence explanation.

criteria.name: Weighing and conditional judgement

descriptors.Beginning: Gives an unsupported preference or a list of pros/cons without answering extent/conditions.
descriptors.Developing: Offers counter-perspective or a condition but weighs reasons weakly or generically.
descriptors.Secure: Weighs a credible counter-perspective against evidence and answers with a justified condition.
descriptors.Extending: Explains why one consideration carries more weight here and what evidence/condition would change the judgement.

criteria.collection: P: conclusion; C: strongest objection/change your mind.
criteria.repair: Identify competing reasons, state the weighing criterion and test a changed condition.

rubrics.conversion: No automatic percentage or IB grade conversion; teacher applies approved reporting policy
rubrics.review_note: Recovered existing rubric. Review terminology, support language and outcome links before approving for field capture.

descriptors.Beginning: Major mask, overlap or light errors prevent the intended image from working.
descriptors.Developing: The build works in part, but visible edge, depth or tonal conflicts remain.
descriptors.Secure: Masks, overlap and relevant light/tonal cues support a coherent composition; source content remains editable.
descriptors.Extending: A changed arrangement is resolved convincingly and the student explains why the new relationships work.

descriptors.Beginning: The intended product/message or reading order is unclear.
descriptors.Developing: The message is identifiable, but competing type or effects weaken the intended visual idea.
descriptors.Secure: Composition, type and image treatment communicate a deliberate idea to the stated audience.
descriptors.Extending: The idea remains effective through a justified adaptation to a new constraint or format.

descriptors.Beginning: The source cannot be meaningfully revised or the required output is absent.
descriptors.Developing: An editable file and output exist, but organisation, output checks or the reason for revision is incomplete.
descriptors.Secure: The editable source, checked output and traceable revision support a clear handoff.
descriptors.Extending: The student handles an unfamiliar but related client change efficiently and explains the production trade-off.

rubrics.assistance: Record guidance and approved accommodations separately. Following the first demonstration does not by itself establish independent transfer.

descriptors.Developing: Product and message are present, but cutout, arrangement or text treatment interferes with communication.
descriptors.Secure: Images and editable text form a complete, readable advertisement for the stated purpose.
descriptors.Extending: The student applies the taught process to a changed audience or arrangement and explains the improvement.

descriptors.Secure: Hierarchy, contrast and type choices make the main message and supporting information readable.
descriptors.Extending: An audience test leads to a specific, effective adjustment, with the reason demonstrated.

descriptors.Beginning: The student cannot yet connect the attempted change to the communication problem.
descriptors.Developing: A change is made, but its relationship to the brief or feedback is only partly explained.
descriptors.Secure: The student makes a relevant taught change and explains the visible effect using the actual file.
descriptors.Extending: The student transfers the design to a related label/sign or new viewing context and identifies what needed to change.

rubrics.title: Truck Ad — editable image, visual hierarchy and changed brief
rubrics.review_note: Skill and checkpoint mappings reconciled with the original Truck Ad step map and Form specification. Guided work remains practice; assess the changed brief, editable file and explanation. Teacher approval and classroom moderation remain pending.

criteria.name: Editable image construction

descriptors.Beginning: The intended composite is incomplete or visible edge, placement or editability problems prevent its use.
descriptors.Developing: The image is assembled and partly editable; visible edge or treatment inconsistencies remain at the intended output size.
descriptors.Secure: The composite reads coherently at the intended size. Masks and adjustment controls preserve the source and allow a targeted revision; the learner locates and explains those controls.
descriptors.Extending: The learner adapts the editable construction to a substantially changed source or constraint and demonstrates why the revised method better meets that condition.

criteria.collection: Product: layered master and export. Observation: locate and revise one controlling mask or adjustment. Conversation: explain why the edit is reversible.
criteria.repair: Compare the edge at output size; change one controlling mask and verify both versions.

criteria.name: Hierarchy and visual design

descriptors.Beginning: The intended first-read message is unclear or essential text cannot be read at the required size.
descriptors.Developing: The main message is visible, but type, contrast, spacing or competing elements weaken the reading order.
descriptors.Secure: Type roles, scale, contrast and spacing establish a purposeful reading order. An audience read test supports the final revision.
descriptors.Extending: A changed audience or format requires a materially different hierarchy; the learner compares alternatives and uses audience evidence to justify the adaptation.

criteria.collection: Product: original and revised export. Conversation: identify the first read and point to the design choices that create it.
criteria.repair: Change one hierarchy variable, repeat the five-second read test and explain the result.

criteria.name: Communicating a message for an audience

descriptors.Beginning: The visual treatment and words do not yet communicate the intended message to the specified audience.
descriptors.Developing: Some choices fit the audience and purpose, but the explanation does not connect those choices to their likely effect.
descriptors.Secure: Image and words work together for the stated audience and purpose. The learner supports the design explanation with visible evidence and a purposeful revision.
descriptors.Extending: The learner evaluates two plausible treatments under a changed brief, explains a trade-off and identifies when the rejected alternative could be more effective.

criteria.collection: Product: independent variant. Conversation: a 60–90 second changed-brief defence.
criteria.repair: State the audience's intended response, identify one conflicting choice and test a revision.

rubrics.support_rule: Record Guided, Supported, Independent or Transfer separately. Do not lower the descriptor because access support was used.
rubrics.knowledge_rule: Knowledge and reflection guide follow-up; no automatic arithmetic contribution to outcome achievement.
rubrics.powerschool: Teacher confirms each outcome and writes the reporting comment; no automatic percentage conversion.

rubrics.title: Truck Ad — graphic message and transfer to village signage
rubrics.review_note: Use the shared workbook as design practice. Assess the independent graphic message and its adaptation to a Snowy Village sign. This assesses graphic communication; technical drawing and fabrication need their own later evidence.

criteria.name: Design and colour choices

descriptors.Beginning: Arrangement or colour relationships obstruct the intended visual message.
descriptors.Developing: Design principles and colour are visible in places but competing choices weaken emphasis or readability.
descriptors.Secure: Arrangement, contrast and colour relationships support a clear emphasis and coherent message; the learner explains their effect using the work.
descriptors.Extending: The learner tests and adapts design and colour choices for a different viewing context and justifies the trade-off with comparison evidence.

criteria.collection: Product: two exports. Conversation: identify emphasis and explain one colour decision.

criteria.name: Typography for reading conditions

descriptors.Beginning: Type choices or spacing prevent essential information from being read.
descriptors.Developing: Text is readable in the main working view but hierarchy or spacing fails in the intended viewing conditions.
descriptors.Secure: Type roles, scale and spacing communicate a clear reading order at the intended size and distance; testing informs a revision.
descriptors.Extending: The learner adapts typography to the smaller physical sign or another changed viewing condition and explains what had to change and why.

criteria.collection: Product: design and sign proof at actual size. Observation: viewing-distance test.

criteria.name: Image and word communicate together

descriptors.Beginning: Image and words convey conflicting or incomplete messages.
descriptors.Developing: The intended message is identifiable, but image and word choices make the audience work to understand it.
descriptors.Secure: Image and words reinforce one clear message suited to the specified audience; the learner identifies evidence of audience response.
descriptors.Extending: The learner transfers the message to a changed medium or audience, evaluates two alternatives and explains a defensible design decision.

criteria.collection: Product: independent advert and village-sign adaptation. Conversation: changed-medium defence.

rubrics.support_rule: Support context is recorded separately from achievement.
